displayName: loop-sessions: Slack live pass failing for 15 min

documentation.content:
The Slack mirror's live pass has failed on every run for fifteen minutes. Nothing is being mirrored and nobody's thread is moving. The pass logs its error on the `slack live pass failed` line.

`gcloud logging read 'resource.labels.service_name="loop-sessions" AND jsonPayload.message="slack live pass failed"' --limit=5 --freshness=30m` for the error. `invalid_auth` means the bot token (secret `loop-sessions-slack-bot-token`) needs rotating; a database error means the pass could not read slack_posts, and the readiness alert will say why. The runbook "live Slack threads" in examples/deploy-gcp/README.md has the per-message levers.

Runbook: examples/deploy-gcp/README.md#runbook-live-slack-threads
